items.text: If we were paying interest on the debt of 10% last year, the cost of our interest on the debt would be ~$2 Trillion. Almost the cost Social Security and Medicare combined.

Many economists don’t think it will get this bad, but if it rises to even 5%, the cost will be $1 Trillion in annual payments.  For comparison, the Federal Government spends ~$1.2 Trillion per year on Social Security and ~$1.4 Trillion on Medicare.
